WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_end__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[2]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_start__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "amount", "purchased_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "purchases"
  ON "item_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND "purchased_at" <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND "purchased_at" > tmp.__kumo_start__
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at", "purchase_id", "amount"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "items" WHERE "item_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__) as __kumo_matches__, "item_id", "category", "price"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "items" ent
  ON ent.rowid = (
    SELECT rowid
    FROM "items"
    WHERE "item_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__
    ORDER BY "category", "item_id", "price", rowid
    LIMIT 1
)
